name: describe_image
description: Look at an image file with a vision model and return what it shows or the answer to a question about it: read a receipt or a label, transcribe a whiteboard, say what is in a photo, check whether a light is on. Use it whenever an image was attached and you cannot see images yourself (the message says where it was saved, usually /data/uploads/...), or for a second, careful look. Uses xAI Grok, OpenAI or Claude, whichever key the household has.

path.description: Path of the image under /data, e.g. /data/uploads/123-photo.jpg (given in the message when the image arrived)

question.description: What to find out about the image; empty = a precise general description including any text in it

max_tokens.description: Length cap for the answer, default 800
